{{Quote|I grew up on Generis, where my parents owned and operated a wilderness ranch on a white-water stretch of the Atrivis River&hellip;The place attracted wealthy travelers who wanted to experience the wilderness in comfort. For my siblings and me, that meant catering to their needs all hours of the day and night. As more and more guests began to arrive with their children in tow, it became my responsibility to entertain them while their parents were out fishing, hunting, hiking, or running the rapids&hellip;I heard wonderful stories about Mid and Outer Rim worlds, which only reinforced my desire to escape Generis as soon as I could.|[[Vistal Purn]], a Generis resident|<ref name="MF" />}}
'''Generis''' was a high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]] of the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. It had rugged terrain and was covered with [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains and vast jungles. This natural beauty attracted offworld travelers keen to experience its wilderness. Prior to the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the world was settled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] as part of their [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Following the collapse of their society, scattered temples were all that remained of their time on Generis. The planet was later settled by a mix of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other [[Species/Legends|species]], as was another planet in the system, [[Atrivis 7]].

The planet was within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but remained neutral. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it became a hub of resistance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Joint resistance forces in the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector]] set up a [[Generis orbital base|centralized base]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the planet before negotiating a [[Treaty of Generis|treaty]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. As part of this accord, an [[Outer Rim Communications Center]] was constructed on the planet, protected by a small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] force. Generis became a strategic location for the Alliance, from where it coordinated forces stationed throughout the Atrivis sector. The base was later [[Fall of Generis|captured]] by the forces of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|sustained campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Eventually recaptured by the Republic, the base was again [[Battle of Generis (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]], this time during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The assault by the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders intent on conquering the galaxy destroyed much of the planet's surface, but when the Yuuzhan Vong were eventually defeated by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the Generis Communications Center was restored to operating capacity.

==Description==
{{Quote|The ''<nowiki>[</nowiki>S9-series heavy power droid<nowiki>]</nowiki>'' is ideally suited for use on planets with rough terrain (like Tatooine or Generis); consequently, the Rebel Alliance is trying to purchase or capture as many of these droids as it can.|[[Hkaeli]], on [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]|<ref name="CFT">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
Generis was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of stunning natural beauty located in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]]<ref name="RASB" /><ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', Vol 1, 331.</ref>&mdash;sometimes alternatively known as the Atrivis [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="TLCSB" /><ref name="TTSB">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>&mdash;a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SWR" /> It was the primary planet in the system,<ref name="CSWE" /> which also contained [[Atrivis]]<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> and [[Atrivis 7]].<ref name="Cestus">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> The Generis day lasted 42 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], while its year was 234 days long. Generis's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was 1.1 times the Imperial standard, and its atmosphere was [[Atmosphere/Legends|Type I]]<ref name="TLCSB" />&mdash;a mix of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] and other gases that was suitable for [[Human/Legends|Human]] and comparable [[Species/Legends|species]]' respiration<ref name="Planets collection">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>&mdash;with a hot and humid climate.<ref name="TLCSB" />

The terrain of Generis was rough;<ref name="CFT" /> there were many rocky hills and mountains, and thick lush jungle covered much of its landmasses. Much of Generis remained untamed wilderness, with thick jungle foliage soon choking any trails blazed through it. The jungles were full of indigenous creatures and flora,<ref name="TLCSB" /> including [[Grass/Legends|grasses]]<ref name="SWR" /> and dense impenetrable groves of [[sallap]] trees.<ref name="CoD" /> Much of Generis' surface was covered by large [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]],<ref name="SWR" /> while lakes dotted the landmasses<ref name="CoD" /> and [[river]]s of white-[[Water/Legends|water]] rapids crossed the landscape.<ref name="MF" /> The planet also had at least one outcrop of [[hiridiu crystal]], located at its southern pole.<ref name="TLCSB" /> Much of the planet's surface was destroyed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].<ref name="CSWE" />

Generis was located on the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through the Atrivis sector after branching off the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] at the [[Fedje system/Legends|Fedje system]]. Bracketing Generis on this route were the [[Devon system/Legends|Devon system]]&mdash;on its coreward side&mdash;and the [[Markbee's Star system/Legends|Markbee's Star system]]&mdash;on its rimward side.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
{{Quote|On distant Generis stands an especially dark, dense, and near impenetrable growth of sallap trees. For many generations it was necessary to travel a long distance around the forest to reach the glorious deep-water lake on the far side. But then a Sith Lord thought to blaze a trail directly through the trees, in the hope of providing a quicker route to the lake.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="CoD" />}}
Around the year [[30,000 BBY]], the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] became a significant [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] power. Using [[Force-drive|Force-based hyperdrives]], they traveled to many worlds around the galaxy that possessed significant signatures in the Force, uniting them to form the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Among these worlds was Generis,<ref name="TEA" /> where they constructed large [[Rakatan temple|temples]].<ref name="TLCSB" /> After five thousand years of galactic dominance, plague caused the collapse of the Infinite Empire,<ref name="TEA" /> and the species later became extinct on Generis. Their temples collapsed into ruins overtaken by the jungle, leaving no clues for later settlers as to how or why they [[Death/Legends|died out]].<ref name="TLCSB" />

The area of space around Generis was explored following the blazing of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], circa [[3000 BBY|3000]]&ndash;[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Generis was lightly settled during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CoD" /> alongside another planet in the system, Atrivis 7.<ref name="Cestus" /> It was known to the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] by [[68 BBY/Legends|68 BBY]],<ref name="Date">In ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', Obi-Wan Kenobi is 24 years old. Qui-Gon Jinn tells Kenobi that Yoda told him this parable when he was younger than Kenobi was then. As Jinn was born in 92 BBY, he would have been 24 years old in 68 BBY.</ref> who used a parable based on the planet to educate his students about the dangers of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. According to Yoda, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] tried to blaze a path directly through a grove of sallap trees as a shortcut to a lake on Generis. However, while the path was shorter, it failed to reach its destination. This parable was later retold by Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="CoD" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;a conflict that consumed much of the galaxy between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&mdash;Generis was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-controlled space;<ref name="TEA" /> however, in the year [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Generis was one of the thousands of undecided worlds that had not made an out-and-out declaration for the Republic nor its opposing government, the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 54">{{FactFile|54|WOR 1-2|J9 Worker Drone}}</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|The place attracted wealthy travelers who wanted to experience the wilderness in comfort. For my siblings and me, that meant catering to their needs all hours of the day and night&hellip;Generis was far removed from the effects of Imperial rule, but guests at the ranch kept my family well informed of galactic developments.|[[Vistal Purn]] recounts life under the Galactic Empire|<ref name="MF" />}}
During the period of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Generis was under the jurisdiction of an [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]],<ref name="TLCSB" /> but its residents were far removed from the effects of Imperial rule.<ref name="MF" /> In contrast, the Atrivis sector in which Generis was located was foremost among the territories active in resisting the Empire, with many isolated groups of freedom fighters. After [[Mantooine Liberators|one such group]] was [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|massacred]] on [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]], many of the resistance groups began to cooperate, eventually forming the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]]. The ARG leaders chose the Generis system as their base of operations, establishing a [[Generis orbital base|secret base]] on an abandoned [[Space station/Legends|space station]] there. From there, the ARG harassed the Imperial forces throughout the sector. They were eventually visited by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] intent on forging a pan-galactic [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Although at first hesitant to join her, the leadership of the ARG eventually signed the [[Treaty of Generis]] with Mothma, bringing the ARG into the wider Rebel Alliance.<ref name="RASB" />

[[File:Varth-RASB.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Varth/Legends|Varth]] was stationed on Generis.]]
As part of the treaty, the Alliance built a [[Outer Rim Communications Center|Communications Center]] on Generis,<ref name="RASB" /> selecting a site at its southern pole. It was located next to a large deposit of hiridiu crystal, which, merely by proximity, had the capacity to boost modern communications signal strength by as much as 30%. The Alliance was also impressed with the rugged terrain of Generis, knowing that if the base was ever discovered by the Empire, any attempt to capture or disable the center would require an extended ground campaign.<ref name="TLCSB" /> The Alliance sent a team of engineers and technicians to construct the communications facility, as well as some [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] docks as additional protection. The Alliance also supplied a full wing of 36 starfighters to the Atrivis forces, under the command of [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Varth/Legends|Varth]]. Six of these craft were permanently stationed on Generis to protect the Communications Center. Within six months, with an influx of Alliance training and resources, the ARG had became a fully operational [[Atrivis Sector Force|Sector Force]].<ref name="RASB" /> The Rebel Alliance also sought [[S9-series heavy power droid]]s for service on the planet, as the model was particularly appropriate for its rugged terrain.<ref name="CFT" />

Some eight months after the [[Battle in the Yuvern system|Battle of Yuvern]] in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]], the newly-coordinated communications system in the Atrivis sector bore fruit. The Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the neighboring Oplovis sector moved to attack Rebel forces on Mantooine, passing through the Generis system ''en route''. When the Imperial forces emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], three Alliance [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] [[Battle of the Generis system|ambushed]] them, taking them completely by surprise. They defeated the Oplovis fleet without any major Alliance losses.<ref name="RASB" />

===New Republic===
{{Quote|I thought you were out in Atrivis sector, baby-sitting the Outer Rim comm center.''"<br />"''You're behind the times, Generis fell three days ago.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Empire suffered a critical defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], including the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. With fragmentation and infighting affecting much of the Empire, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] established the [[Pentastar Alignment]], an Imperial faction that adhered to the principles of Emperor Palpatine's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] but eschewed expansionism. Located with the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]], it included fifteen sectors within its borders, including Generis' own Atrivis sector, from [[4 ABY/Legends|4]]&ndash;[[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. The Rebel Alliance, which transitioned into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the Battle of Endor, did not engage with the Alignment, instead focusing their attention on other Imperial factions.<ref name="TEA" /> They did maintain their presence on Generis, however, with its Communications Center becoming the prime New Republic communications nexus to and from the Outer Rim Territories, and shortly after Endor, they strengthened Generis base with the [[Cracken Flight Group]] led by [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]].<ref name="TLCSB" /> For a short period, the Cracken Flight Group was left under the stewardship of Wing Commander Varth while Cracken volunteered with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the Republic in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Cracken returned to Generis.<ref name="DB" /> Later that year, all of the forces under Wing Commander Varth were temporarily moved toward the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to cover some of the sectors formerly used by rogue Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]], basing themselves out of [[Folor]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Generis.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Fall of Generis|Battle of Generis]].]]
They had returned to Generis by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], at which time the New Republic had suffered numerous losses against [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] strategic mastermind who had returned from an extended placement in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. As part of his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic, Thrawn personally planned an assault against Generis.<ref name="TLC" /> Carried out on 44:8:19,<ref name="TEA" /> and utilizing some of his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]], the Imperial ground assault won a fierce [[Fall of Generis|battle]], capturing the Communications Center largely intact, along with most of the sector fleet supply deposits. Cracken and his Flight Group were able to provide enough resistance to allow [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kryll]] to sneak out [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] [[Travia Chan/Legends|Travia Chan]] and her support staff, and were also able to deny the Imperial forces any new ships;<ref name="TLC" /> however, overall, the loss of the unique broadcasting center was a significant blow to the New Republic.<ref name="TLCSB" /> Among the Imperial casualties was the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Grodin Tierce]]; [[19 ABY/Legends|ten years]] later, Tierce was impersonated by members of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in a bid to take control of that government.<ref name="VF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> Thrawn's forces later destroyed the Communications Center.<ref name="CSWE" />

Grand Admiral Thrawn was subsequently defeated by the New Republic, assassinated by his own bodyguard.<ref name="TLC" /> His second-in-command, [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], worked to consolidate the Empire's control in the New Territories, but was eventually pushed back to a mere eight sectors, with the Republic regaining control of Generis and the Atrivis sector.<ref name="TEA" /> The Communications Center was rebuilt,<ref name="CSWE" /> which, in addition to servicing the Outer Rim, also became an important link to the Unknown Regions. While this held some strategic importance, it was never selected for sabotage by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], as they considered the Chiss&mdash;the dominant power in the Unknown Regions&mdash;to be too isolationist for the Republic to make any successful overtures.<ref name="FH3">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the New Republic again came under [[Yuuzhan Vong War|substantial attack]], this time from an extra-galactic species known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. For the early years of the war, Generis was a Republic stronghold;<ref name="TEA" /> however, in 28 ABY, a Yuuzhan Vong fleet retreating from an assault on the Imperial Remnant [[Battle of Generis (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] Generis, having been alerted to the base by the presence of a Yuuzhan Vong [[Spy/Legends|spy]] using a communications [[villip]]. Although pursued by Grand Admiral Pellaeon aboard the ''[[Right to Rule]]'', the Yuuzhan Vong managed to destroy the Communications Center,<ref name="FH3" /> ravaging much of the planet's surface in the process.<ref name="CSWE" /> The Yuuzhan Vong force then continued on to the planet [[Esfandia/Legends|Esfandia]], which had been established as a second Outer Rim communications base at the start of the war to serve as a redundant link to the Outer Rim and into the Unknown Regions alongside Generis. Esfandia almost fell to the same force, but Pellaeon's ships and the arrival of a rag-tag fleet of [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]]-affiliated starships managed to [[Battle of Esfandia|defeat]] the Yuuzhan Vong forces. The New Republic was soon able to repair the Generis facility and restore its communications capacity.<ref name="FH3" />

In the decades after the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Empire expanded its territories again, gaining control of the Atrivis sector by [[41 ABY]]. A century later, the Empire had regained control of the galaxy through an alliance with the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Order]]. After the Sith usurped the throne of Emperor [[Roan Fel]], Generis was part of the [[Empire-in-exile|territory]] that remained loyal to the displaced ruler.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
===Locals===
{{Quote|It'll beat what we've got out on Generis. It's backward enough that most folks there don't even realize the Old Republic has fallen.''"<br />"''And they're wondering why nothing new is being shipped from Alderaan.|[[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="BW" />}}
[[File:Rakata_profile.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] once inhabited Generis.]]
Generis was once inhabited by the Rakata.<ref name="TEA" /> These [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] had large, cone-like heads with eyes on short stalks on the sides.<ref name="KOTORguide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> They built temples across the surface of Generis in a notably non-Human design. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, they were long extinct, with the temple ruins providing no evidence of what caused their disappearance.<ref name="TLCSB" />

The planet was later lightly settled by the early years of the Galactic Empire with a mix of Humans and a variety of other species, but it had no major [[City/Legends|cities]]; by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], its population numbered only 2,000.<ref name="TLCSB" /> There were some small population centers, as well as wilderness ranches on the planet. Wealthy travelers from off-world often visited the planet to experience its untamed wilderness, bringing along their children and staying at ranches such as that of [[Vistal Purn]]'s family, located near the [[Atrivis River]]. These guests spent their time fishing, hunting, hiking, and rafting down the white-water rapids. Purn, one of the Generis locals, eventually left the planet and became the owner of a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], a starship that later became famous as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], captained by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a hero of the Rebel Alliance and New Republic.<ref name="MF" />

The inhabitants of Generis utilized certain galactic technologies, such as [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]],<ref name="MF" /> but on the whole, the world was rather backward.<ref name="BW" /> The planet's inhabitants were distant from the effect and management of Imperial rule, and were only kept up to date on galactic affairs through news related by offworld guests.<ref name="MF" /> Even when the planet became a key Republic communications hub, the locals remained ambivalent to galactic affairs. Pash Cracken, stationed on the world for years, once joked that "most folks there don't even realize the Old Republic has fallen."<ref name="BW" />

===Military personnel===
{{Quote|And we were able to make enough trouble on our way out to let General Kryll sneak Travia Chan and her people out from under the Imperials' collective snout.|[[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
During the Galactic Civil War, the Atrivis Resistance Group used Generis as their headquarters, first from an abandoned orbital space station and later from a base established at the planet's southern pole. The ARG was led by Commander-in-Chief Travia Chan, a Human invalid forced to remain near the base's medical facilities. She was often aided by [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] [[Loom Carplin]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] subordinate [[Busurra]]. Other members of the Generis command staff included General Kryll, an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] and former Imperial placed in charge of the Outer Rim Communications Center, and Wing Commander Varth, who was in charge of the starfighter forces.<ref name="RASB" /> Serving under Varth for many years was Pash Cracken, son of the legendary Alliance General [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].<ref name="TLCSB" /> Pash Cracken commanded the Cracken Flight Group, a crack unit of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]], composed of pilots that had followed him when he defected from the Empire soon after graduating from the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]].<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

==Locations==
{{Quote|I grew up on Generis, where my parents owned and operated a wilderness ranch on a white-water stretch of the Atrivis River. The ranch was a four-day walk from the closest population center, but most guests opted to pay extra to be delivered by airspeeder, which could make the trip in a little under a standard hour.|[[Vistal Purn]]|<ref name="MF" />}}
Ruins of Rakatan temples, of a distinctly exotic and alien design, dotted the Generis jungle.<ref name="RASB" /><ref name="TEA" /> On other worlds such as [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], these Rakatan temples were four-sided stone pyramids.<ref name="Path of destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> Other notable locations on Generis included the Purn family wilderness ranch, located on the Atrivis River. It hosted numerous offworld visitors seeking a wilderness experience.<ref name="MF" />

Generis base was the name of the Rebel Alliance facility on Generis. It contained the Outer Rim Communications Center, Atrivis Sector Headquarters, and the sector's starfighter base. The complex lacked sufficient mechanics and spare parts, and, as it was not originally designed for starfighters, had primitive maintenance facilities.<ref name="RASB" /> Generis base was located at the planet's southern pole next to an outcrop of hiridiu crystal.<ref name="TLCSB" /> The base also contained supply depots for the sector. The Communications Center was captured intact by Grand Admiral Thrawn,<ref name="TLC" /> and later regained by the Republic which did some further expansion on the site.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Generis is first mentioned in the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] supplement written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]]. The planet is mentioned by [[Timothy Zahn]] in his [[1993]] novel ''[[The Last Command]]''. Since this time, it has been mentioned in novels and reference books, but has appeared directly only in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|computer]] [[Star Wars video games|game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].

In both the first and [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|second editions]] of the ''Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', the planet's spelling alternates between "Generis" and "Gerenis." This source originally places the planet in the Generis system, which has been repeated in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]].<ref name="DB" /><ref name="CSWE" /> However, other sources have placed it the Atrivis system,<ref name="TLCSB" /><ref name="TTSB" /> and so these names must be alternatives for the same star system. Within ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' there is also an error regarding Generis. On page 122, it is described as one of the systems on the Braxant Run, however, on page 202, the Braxant takes a different path, and Generis is instead located on the Relgim Run.<ref name="TEA" /> This article has treated the placement on the Braxant as in error.

There is some ambiguity as to the nature of the Alliance presence on Generis. In the ''Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', the original resistance base is described as an abandoned space station. With regard to the new Rebel communications base, the book suggests it is continuous with the resistance base stating that "in its original incarnation, Generis base was not designed to house starfighters, and maintenance facilities are primitive," while at the same time referring to it as "the base on Gerenis," suggesting it is on the planet's surface.<ref name="RASB" /> However, the ''Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook'' cites the rugged terrain as a factor in building the communications center, placing it on the ground.<ref name="TLCSB" /> As such, it is not clear whether the Rebel Alliance base was first integrated into the space station and then moved to the surface or built directly on the surface.

Another inconsistency occurs over the capture of the ORCC. ''The Last Command'' describes the center being lost "more or less intact," while ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' holds that "the center was destroyed by Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces just prior to the Battle of Bilbringi." This article tries to harmonize the sources, indicating the base was captured intact and then later destroyed.

The video game ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' provides travel times between Generis and other planets in its sector; however, these are often significantly longer than other canonical sources and thus seem to reflect game mechanics rather than canonical travel times. With this proviso, the times given for Generis are as follows:
